confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors reflect typical Japanese menu pricing; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July rates vary with demand and events. USD values assume about 150 JPY per USD, so a large yen move would shift them. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 1.5x beer, wine about 1.2x beer) because direct local knowledge is thinner. No live listings or booking pages were checked. The RBA rate came only from search-result summaries that I could not open or corroborate, and their dates conflicted, so verify the row before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to smaller Kansai heritage cities near Kyoto and Osaka, from general knowledge rather than live data. Restaurant prices track national Japanese norms; accommodation sits below Kyoto but above rural Japan.
